profile.headline: Software Engineering Technical Lead
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineering technical lead who has successfully led small teams on time-sensitive projects and has been recognized for my initiative, innovation, agility, teamwork, and high quality of work. After 16+ years working for financial and technology companies, I achieved financial independence at age 40 and pursued an early semi-retired lifestyle centered around world travel, ultramarathon running and personal finance. Since 2021, I have leveraged my software engineering expertise to create innovative solutions to rapidly grow the e-commerce sales of a small business with 4 store locations.

* Technical Skills: Web software engineer for 18+ years for established financial companies, technology startups and small businesses

* Leadership Skills: Led small engineering teams, mentored engineers, trained running staff

* Communication Skills: Presented demos, conducted team meetings, wrote software documentation

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
* Increased online customer sales by 20% and 40% in 2022 and 2023 by using data-driven analytics to improve customer engagement by making it easier and quicker to search for products, optimizing page layout and product listings, improving desktop and mobile website usability and responsiveness, and integrating Google Reviews to build customer trust.

* Increased organic search traffic by 11% in 2023 by analyzing Google Analytics and Google Search Console data to optimize frequently viewed web pages, create new marketing content based on popular queries, and build brand and category specific shopping pages to increase SEO reach.

* Developed custom solutions using HTML, JavaScript and CSS to add new functionality and design elements for e-commerce and marketing requirements not directly supported WordPress.

positions.title: Sales Key Holder
positions.description:
* Increased sales by 31% during the 2020 holiday shopping season as Key Holder at the Draper store by improving visual merchandising of high value products and accessories, enhancing the spatial design of the store, proactively managing inventory levels, and training employees.

* Received 18 five-star Google and Yelp reviews from customers for my expertise in fitting customers to the proper running shoes and/or insoles for their needs and goals.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Management Engineering
positions.description:
* Led a team of 3 engineers, mentored junior engineers, presented technical demos, performed code reviews, conducted stand-up meetings, and strongly advocated agile development.

* Improved security, performance, scalability, and reliability of application provisioning for the vRealize Application Services Java web app.

* Enhanced alerting intelligence and improved the performance of infrastructure, application, and middleware monitoring for the vRealize Hyperic Java web app.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Seller Dashboard
positions.description: * Led a team of 4 engineers that developed self-serve features for over 3000 product shopping merchants to manage and optimize their accounts to improve click-through rates.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: * Led a team of 3 web developers that quickly delivered new features for virtual trading, predictive markets, and white-label partner integration.

positions.title: Software Developer, Bond Market
positions.description:
* Led a team of 2 developers that delivered international bonds, portfolio management, and multiple order execution to a Java trading platform for over 15,000 financial advisors.

* Increased revenue and commissions for Merrill Lynch by designing a bond portfolio optimizer that recommended ways to optimize income for client’s accounts.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer, Life & Health
positions.description:
* Automated 70% of underwriting workflow processes for 7 insurance companies by developing Java web services to perform case submission, decision screening, and work distribution.

* Developed a Java web-based client management system that centralized data from 5 sources and integrated with legacy systems to web-enable marketing and treaty processes.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: * Streamlined GE's human resources workflows by creating a new Java web-based employee review system, adding new career services on GEcareers.com for 8 GE businesses to replace CareerMosaic.com, and integrating an internal job search system with HireSystems.com.

positions.title: Senior Design Engineer, Commercial Engines
positions.description: * Designed PW4000 engine parts for Boeing 777 airplanes for manufacturability and durability by modeling thermal engineering problems to predict vibratory motions and stresses.

honors.title: VMware Above & Beyond Award – Team Success
